CheckTitle: CodeBuild report unencrypted group export to S3
Description: CodeBuild report group exports destined for S3 buckets are not encrypted at rest.
Risk: Unencrypted report exports contain test execution logs, coverage metrics, and vulnerability scan output that could be compromised if S3 bucket permissions fail.

Recommendation.Text: Configure report group export settings to enable S3 encryption at rest or specify an AWS KMS key for export encryption.
